title: The Deposit Asked for on a Resort Lodging Reservation
content:
The deposit asked for on a Resort Lodging reservation is worked out on the nightly average of the room rate standing on the folio for the stay, that is the room rate standing on the folio divided by the number of nights it covers, multiplied by the fewest nights the unit type is let for outside its published peak and holiday windows. The unit type's deposit share of that amount is taken, and the whole of the unit type's incidental hold is collected with it in advance against incidentals. The amounts are carried at full precision through every step and the deposit asked for is rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end. An amount that falls exactly halfway between two cents is rounded to the cent whose last digit is even, which is the convention the collective's finance office settles every folio on.

The deposit asked for is fixed only after the folio carries the room rate posted for every night of the stay.

## The quantities and where they are read

| Quantity | Where it is read |
| --- | --- |
| The room rate standing on the folio for the stay | the room rate entries on the reservation's folio |
| The number of nights that room rate covers | the nights those same folio entries carry |
| The nightly average | the room rate standing on the folio divided by the number of nights it covers |
| The fewest nights the unit type is let for outside its published peak and holiday windows | the letting limits published for the unit type |
| The unit type's deposit share | the deposit share published for the unit type |
| The unit type's incidental hold | the incidental hold published for the unit type |

### A worked deposit (hypothetical figures throughout)

Take a folio carrying a room rate of 1200.00 USD over 4 nights, on a unit type whose fewest nights outside both published windows is taken here as 2, whose deposit share is taken as 30 percent and whose incidental hold is taken as 350.00 USD.

The nightly average is 1200.00 USD divided by 4 nights, which is 300.00 USD. Multiplied by the 2 nights the unit type is let for outside its published peak and holiday windows, that gives 600.00 USD. The unit type's deposit share of 30 percent of 600.00 USD is 180.00 USD. Collected with it is the whole of the unit type's incidental hold of 350.00 USD, giving 530.00 USD, which is rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end, as the deposit asked for.
